answer: Scores decay 3% per idle day, and any attempt to link two identities wipes both back to zero. Every quorum must span three unrelated subnetworks, so a rack of machines in one datacenter never forms a jury. Example: an identity that skips a day drops from 80 to 77.6, and a second skipped day costs more than the first. A ripple of inactivity reaches the whole thread of dependents, because each vouch inherits part of the decay. At the zenith the decay is invisible; after a week it is the only number that matters.
